content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

The core of selling digital products like music lies in having a reliable infrastructure that allows you to receive payments directly, without losing a significant portion to fees. In many regions, traditional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive, leaving creators sidelined. This guide translates the technical aspects of setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack into actionable insights. By adopting a system that uses decentralized payment solutions, you can regain control over your sales, ensure that every dollar earned is maximized, and reach a global audience without the typical barriers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of this infrastructure are several key components working together: hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. By utilizing platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, you create a stable foundation at no cost. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers can serve as the backend logic for order processing. The integration of NOWPayments allows for crypto payments without the need for a buyer account, ensuring transactions are smooth and instantaneous. This architecture not only simplifies the payment process but also automates the delivery of your digital products, streamlining your operations and enhancing customer satisfaction.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who are often marginalized by conventional payment systems. Artists, musicians, and content creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela face unique challenges when trying to monetize their work. This architecture provides them with the tools necessary to build their online storefronts and maintain full control over their sales. By embracing this model, creators can sell their music and other digital products without the constraints imposed by traditional platforms, allowing them to thrive in the digital marketplace.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, keeping more revenue in your pocket.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this setup hinges on a combination of free and low-cost tools. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting keeps expenses minimal. The backend logic provided by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers ensures your store operates smoothly. NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions, providing a simple, secure, and cost-effective way to accept various cryptocurrencies. Additionally, using services like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management and Google Drive for file storage ensures that every aspect of your digital commerce operation is handled efficiently, allowing you to focus on creating.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying your digital commerce stack begins with selecting the appropriate tools. Start by choosing a hosting service like GitHub Pages to set up your website. Next, implement backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for processing orders. Integrate NOWPayments to enable crypto transactions and set up file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, ensure that your store is configured for maximum efficiency. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to simplify this setup, providing everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a decentralized payment infrastructure. Solutions like NOWPayments allow you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, enabling you to retain more of your earnings. This approach bypasses the need for conventional payment processors, allowing for greater control and lower fees on each transaction.
Avoid platform fees by building your own digital storefront with complete control.

By utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can access comprehensive resources to establish a sovereign digital commerce system tailored to your needs. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore these solutions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on Gumroad or Payhip by creating your own online store using GitHub Pages and accepting cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments.
What tools do I need to set up my online store?
You need a hosting platform like GitHub Pages, a backend service like Google Apps Script, and a payment processor such as NOWPayments. Additionally, use Google Drive for file storage and delivery.
